scope: Proposition 3.2 of the manuscript “The Selmer converse for elliptic curves at every prime” (preprints/The-Selmer-converse-for-elliptic-curves-at-every-prime-October-7-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 002 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 bdb2f21b345a4f0f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 11. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are rational primes qi / ∈ S, split completely in L, distinguished places qi of K above them, cyclic p-quotients ∆i of the ring class group of conductor qi, and surjections ℓi : GK −→ ∆i ≃ Z/pni Z, ni −→ ∞, with the following properties. (i) ℓi is unramified outside the pair above qi, its restriction to inertia at qi is surjective, ℓc i = −ℓi, and ℓi|GKs = 0 for every s ∈ S. (ii) vp(qi − 1) − ni is bounded. At either place above p, the full ring class field of conductor qi is unramified and its local degree has bounded p-part. (iii) Frobenius at qi, on all fixed data unramified outside S, tends to an element γ ∈ GL such that ϵ(γ) = 1, det(V (γ) − 1) ̸= 0, C(γ) is not a root of unity. Moreover γ fixes all p-power radicals of a fixed, conjugation-stable finite list in K× spanning O× K,S ⊗ Qp under the Kummer map.
